blocks.text: Sheraton Cebu Mactan Resort marked its fourth anniversary by putting wellness, connection, and purpose at the heart of its month-long celebration. The festivities began with a Pilates and sound healing session led by wellness practitioner Princess Lieza Manzon on September 11, 2026, setting the tone for a series of experiences designed to encourage guests to slow down, reconnect, and make meaningful moments during their stay. “As we celebrate four years, we want to create experiences that leave our guests feeling not only refreshed, but genuinely connected,” said Thel Abiera, Spa Manager.
